title: Execution.
bodyText: The governor shall execute the compact on behalf of this State and perform any other acts that may be deemed requisite to its formal ratification and promulgation.
bodyHtml: [§304A-3203]  Execution.  The governor shall execute the compact on behalf of this State and perform any other acts that may be deemed requisite to its formal ratification and promulgation. [L 2006, c 75, pt of §2]
